title.full: Minimum balance in your MediSave Account

summary.text: There is no minimum amount you must set aside in your MediSave Account.

details.heading: How contributions are allocated
details.body: Part of your working contributions goes to your MediSave Account until it reaches the Basic Healthcare Sum.

example_phrasings: What is the minimum balance I need to set aside in my MediSave Account?
Do I need to keep a minimum amount in MediSave?
Is there a minimum MediSave balance?

sources.page_title: What is the minimum balance I need to set aside in my MediSave Account?

quotes.text: There is no minimum amount required to set aside in your MediSave Account (MA).
A portion of your working contributions will be allocated to your MA until your balance reaches the Basic Healthcare Sum (BHS).
